relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was the nephew of the 19th Bakula Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At the age of twelve the young Rizong Rinpoche was ordained as a novice monk by his uncle the Venerable Bakula Rinpoche.

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: In 1950, he was admitted to Drepung Loseling Monastery in Lhasa for his higher monastic training... Rinpoche remained at Drepung Loseling until the Chinese takeover of Tibet in 1959.

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: At the age of 20, Rizong Rinpoche received his full monk's ordination from the 94th sitting Ganden Tripa Khrichang Lhündrub Tsöndrü.

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was appointed by the 14th Dalai Lama as Abbot of Drepung Loseling (in 1984)

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was appointed by the 14th Dalai Lama as Abbot of Drepung Loseling (in 1984) and of Gyüme Tantric Monastery

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He has also been the Abbot of Samstanling Monastery near Sumur Village in the Nubra Valley of Ladakh.

relations.subject: Rizong Sras Rinpoche
relations.evidence: Prior to becoming the Ganden Tripa, he was the Jangtse Chöje (trans. "Dharma master of the Northern Peak") Rinpoche from Gyüme Tantric College.
